name: Series Library
description: Persistent, structured state for episodic video production: series (cast + style lock), episodes, and per-shot provenance, stored as JSON manifests + media in the durable asset library (series/<slug>/...). Pure local filesystem - no external APIs. Replaces free-text task results with structured episode state the Studio UI reads directly.

skill.name: series_library
skill.description: Structured series/episode/shot state in the persistent asset library: create and read series (cast, style lock), episodes, planned shot lists, and record per-shot artifacts + provenance.
skill.system_prompt:
You manage the persistent series library: the structured state for episodic video production. State lives in JSON manifests on disk (survives every task) - NOT in chat history. Layout: series/<slug>/series.json and series/<slug>/episodes/<NN>/{episode.json, stills/, shots/, final.mp4}.

## Protocol (non-negotiable)
- READ before you act: `series_get` for the style lock (style.block / negative / seed / aspect_ratio / draft_model / final_model) and cast; `episode_get` for the current shot list and statuses. Never work from memory.
- RECORD every artifact the moment it exists: `shot_update` after each still/clip generation (pass the workspace file path - it is COPIED into the series tree automatically), `episode_update` for status/script/final_video. If it is not in the manifest, it did not happen.
- Provenance is mandatory on generated shots: prompt, model, seed (when returned), references, cost_estimate_usd.
- Statuses - episode: draft -> scripted -> generating -> assembled -> published. Shot: planned -> still_ready -> generated -> approved (or failed).
- Cast characters must exist in the avatar library first (fal_avatar). `series_create`/`series_update` validate cast names and will list what is available.
- Script Writer flow: `episode_create` -> write script -> `shots_set` with the full planned shot list ({id, scene, duration_s, description, dialogue:[{character, line}], prompt}). This flips the episode to scripted.
- Scene Director flow: per shot - compose still, `shot_update id=sNN still=... status=still_ready`; generate clip with the series style lock, `shot_update id=sNN clip=... model=... seed=... prompt=... status=generated`.
- Editor flow: assemble, then `episode_update status=assembled final_video=<path>` (copied to final.mp4). The UI reads exactly this - a final video not recorded here is invisible.
- File params accept workspace paths; they are ingested into the episode directory (stills/<id>.png, shots/<id>.mp4, final.mp4) so the workspace janitor cannot destroy them.

tools.name: series_create
tools.description: Create a new series in the persistent library: name, description, cast (validated against the avatar library) and the style lock (style_block, negative, seed, aspect_ratio, draft/final model policy). Fails if the series exists. Returns the created series.json.

name.description: Series name (slug is derived from it).

cast.description: Cast list: [{"character": "maya", "role": "lead detective"}, ...] (or plain character names). Characters must exist in the avatar library.

style_block.description: The style lock: one style directive passed to EVERY image/video generation of this series.

seed.description: Series seed for reproducibility (used where models support it).

draft_model.description: Tool to draft shots with (default scene_video_budget).

tools.name: series_get
tools.description: Read a series: full series.json (cast + style lock) plus an episode summary list (number, title, status, shot count, final_video). ALWAYS call this before generating anything for the series.

tools.name: series_list
tools.description: List all series in the library with episode counts and cast.

tools.name: series_update
tools.description: Patch a series: name, description, cast (revalidated), or style lock fields (style_block, negative, seed, aspect_ratio, draft_model, final_model). Pass "-" to clear a text field. Returns the updated series.json.

tools.name: episode_create
tools.description: Create the next episode of a series (zero-padded numbering, scaffolds stills/ and shots/ dirs, status=draft). Returns the created episode.json and its directory.

script.description: Optional full script text (can be set later via episode_update).

task_id.description: Org task ID producing this episode (for UI cross-linking).

tools.name: episode_get
tools.description: Read an episode: full episode.json including user-uploaded visual references (path + usage note) and the shot list with per-shot status and provenance.

tools.name: episode_update
tools.description: Patch an episode: title, synopsis, status (draft|scripted|generating|assembled|published), script, task_id, duration_s, final_video. final_video accepts a workspace path and is COPIED into the episode dir as final.mp4 - this is how the finished episode becomes visible to the UI.

status.description: New status: draft, scripted, generating, assembled, published.

task_id.description: Org task ID producing this episode.

final_video.description: Path to the assembled episode video (copied to final.mp4).

tools.name: shots_set
tools.description: Replace the episode's planned shot list (Script Writer output). Each shot: {id?, scene, duration_s, description, dialogue:[{character,line}], prompt, references?, model?, seed?, cost_estimate_usd?}. IDs default to s01, s02... Flips a draft episode to scripted. Generation artifacts are recorded later per-shot via shot_update.

shots.description: The full planned shot list (replaces any existing list).

tools.name: shot_update
tools.description: Patch ONE shot by id (creates it if new; all other shots untouched). Records generation artifacts + provenance: still/clip/first_frame/last_frame (workspace paths are COPIED into the episode tree), prompt, model, seed, references, dialogue, status (planned|still_ready|generated|approved|failed), duration_s, cost_estimate_usd. Call this after EVERY generation.

scene.description: Scene number this shot belongs to.
